contract.intent: Validate the Doc Bridge package, real CLI/MCP artifact, documentation, and report UI for the current source revision.

inScope: deterministic documentation quality and structure/code reconciliation
bounded Registry-assisted semantic review of critical documentation and study claims
read-only adjudication of bounded semantic candidates against published metadata and CI evidence
remediation of the previously reported semantic documentation candidates

outcomes.statement: The package builds and its tests pass.
The real CLI, MCP artifact, and discovery flow work.
Documentation checks and repository evidence are valid.
The documentation audit reports measurable quality, coverage, structure gaps, contradictions, and explicit limitations.
Generated documentation has an executable freshness check and its current artifact passes that check.
Two configured Registry review contracts produce bounded, evidence-cited semantic documentation candidates and require human review without applying edits.
The previously reported binary, README-claim, onboarding-redundancy, and corpus-example candidates are resolved with repository evidence.
Bounded semantic candidates are adjudicated against published package metadata, CI configuration, and deterministic gate output without automatic documentation edits.
The README Standard source hashes match the current freshness sources and its executable tests pass.
The versioned quality matrix evaluates semantic correctness, token consistency, cost evidence, generalization, documentation quality, and latency without promoting missing evidence.
The real CLI returns bounded, correctly grounded task handoffs on the declared deterministic fixture, with measured token and response-size cost.
The longitudinal study metrics CLI produces hashed, segmented, missing-data-safe measurements without replacing a baseline.
Study evidence has explicit provenance, privacy, budget, and artifact-hash bindings.
Publication-bound study artifacts pass deterministic privacy scanning.
Study provider cost attribution and independent adjudication remain bounded, failure-safe, and independently testable.
The provider adapter resolves canonical Doc Bridge query identifiers without exposing repository content or accepting unknown automatic query types.
The token-efficiency v2 protocol is valid, historical evidence remains immutable, and publication privacy is enforced.
Controlled study observations preserve labeled context-token attribution, first-evidence latency, provider usage, and independent adjudicator provenance without mixing estimates.
Deterministic agent search reduces bounded context under an explicit budget without losing the expected grounded result and fails closed when the budget is impossible.

The fixed task suite has executable acceptance checks, evidence requirements, safe outcomes, bounded recovery paths, and explicit coverage for documentation freshness, contradictions, and missing documentation.
The reduced public pilot is content-addressed, its final result arithmetic is reproducible, and its published scope is explicitly bounded.
A bounded real-provider pilot records privacy-safe observed context telemetry without exposing raw repository content.
The Registry adapter can invoke a configured CLI with bounded JSON stdin/stdout and fail closed on invalid output.
The report is validated in a real browser and awaits human visual approval.
The verification harness contract itself is tested.

endpoint.reason: This repository is being verified as a CLI/library artifact in this run.

database.reason: This repository has no database-backed behavior in this run.

checks.command: pnpm mcpb:stage && pnpm mcpb:validate && pnpm mcpb:smoke && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["surfaces"]}))'
pnpm build && node bin/ak-docs.js audit documentation --json && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["documentation-audit"]}))'

pnpm build && node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const {parseControlledStudyLedger}=require("./dist/index.js"); const x=parseControlledStudyLedger(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("docs/study/phase4-public-pilot-ledger-v1.json","utf8"))); const observations=x.observations.filter(o=>o.runId==="phase4-public-pilot-04"); const observed=observations.filter(o=>o.execution.status==="completed" && typeof o.model?.provider==="string" && Number.isFinite(o.measurements?.providerTokenCostUnits) && Array.isArray(o.evidenceIds) && o.evidenceIds.every(id=>typeof id==="string")); if(observations.length!==16 || observed.length!==16) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["provider-context-pilot"],runId:"phase4-public-pilot-04",observations:observations.length,observed:observed.length,source:"docs/study/phase4-public-pilot-ledger-v1.json"}));'
pnpm build && node bin/ak-docs.js study metrics docs/study/observation-ledger-v1.json --json --allow-regressions && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["study-metrics"]}))'
pnpm build && node bin/ak-docs.js study verification docs/study/verification-binding-v1.json --json && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["study-verification"]}))'
pnpm build && node scripts/study-privacy-gate.mjs docs/study && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["study-privacy","study-instrumentation","token-efficiency-phase0"]}))'
pnpm build && node bin/ak-docs.js study protocol docs/study/token-efficiency-protocol-v2.json --json && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["token-efficiency-phase0"]}))'

pnpm vitest run tests/study-runner.test.ts tests/study-provider-cli.test.ts tests/study-metrics.test.ts && node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["token-efficiency-phase1"]}))'

node scripts/run-registry-semantic-review.mjs --output-dir=.codex/verification-pr-cleanup-20260913/semantic-review && node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"); const x=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(".codex/verification-pr-cleanup-20260913/semantic-review/report.json","utf8")); if(x.status!=="passed" || x.requiresReview!==true || x.documents.length!==10 || x.results.length!==2) process.exit(1); console.log(JSON.stringify({status:"passed",criteria:["semantic-documentation-review"],models:x.models,documentsReviewed:x.documents.length,outputDir:".codex/verification-pr-cleanup-20260913/semantic-review",requiresReview:true}))'
